wiki_lines: Let $B_0>0$ be in tesla and set $E_0=cB_0/2$ in newtons per coulomb, so $\mathbf E=E_0e_1$, $\mathbf B=B_0e_3$ is subcritical. In [[pthm-rpm-crossed-field-drift]], the drift velocity and boost factor are $\mathbf v_d=-(c/2)e_2$ in metres per second and $\gamma_d=2/\sqrt3$. The constant-velocity orbit $\mathbf x(t)=\mathbf x_0+\mathbf v_dt$ in a chart with $x^0=ct$ solves the adopted model for any $m>0$ and constant charge $q$: its Lorentz force vanishes. This is one exact solution; other initial data yield boosted magnetic orbits.

[F1] [[pthm-rpm-crossed-field-drift]]: for $|E_0|<c|B_0|$, $\mathbf v_d=-(E_0/B_0)e_2$, $\gamma_d=(1-|\mathbf v_d|^2/c^2)^{-1/2}$, and $\mathbf E+\mathbf v_d\times\mathbf B=0$; general solutions are inverse boosts of magnetic orbits.
